d: Short, messy jet black hair with sharp spikes and long bangs framing the face. Narrow, sharp orange-yellow eyes with a stern expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build wearing a tattered, olive-green hooded cloak wrapped around the neck, over a red garment and white bandages on the arm. The only accessory is a thin dark necklace with a small glowing green crystal pendant and a black futuristic handgun.
